image_description: Three vintage comic books arranged on a red and white checkered tablecloth. The top left comic is 'The Mighty Thor' featuring a superhero in action. The bottom left is 'Tales to Astonish' showing a giant monster (Groot) attacking a city. The center/right comic is 'Creatures on the Loose' featuring a werewolf-like creature. All covers display bold, stylized title typography, dynamic illustrated artwork, and price boxes.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: All three objects clearly exhibit the standard rectangular shape and thin profile of staple-bound magazines.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Glossy color cover with illustrated artwork and bold title typography.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Covers are colorful with distinct illustrations. Title typography is prominent and stylized, consistent with the genre.
The comics are lying flat or slightly fanned; the spine edge is not visible enough to confirm staple indentations.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Only the front covers are visible; interior pages and panel layouts are occluded.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Cover art is clearly illustrated. Speech bubbles are visible on the 'Thor' and 'Tales to Astonish' covers.

artifact_observations.location: Title of top-left comic ('The Mighty Thor')
artifact_observations.reasoning: The title text is stylized but structurally inconsistent. The letters 'M', 'I', 'G', 'H', 'T', 'Y' are fused or malformed, lacking clear character separation typical of real printed fonts.
The smaller text below the main title is illegible scribbles that mimic the shape of words but do not form recognizable characters.

artifact_observations.location: Title of bottom-left comic ('Tales to Astonish')
artifact_observations.reasoning: The word 'Astonish' is partially readable but the letterforms are warped and unevenly spaced, indicating AI generation struggles with complex typography.

artifact_observations.location: Red and white checkered tablecloth background
artifact_observations.reasoning: The pattern shows slight perspective distortion and 'waving' near the edges of the comics, suggesting imperfect geometric grounding of the background texture.

artifact_observations.location: Bottom-right corner of the rightmost comic
artifact_observations.reasoning: The edge of the comic blends slightly into the background pattern, lacking a sharp, defined physical boundary.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text auditor's output. AI-generated comics often fail at rendering coherent text. If the titles are nonsensical or the letters are melted together, this is a major artifact. Also, verify if the 'glossy' reflection on the covers matches the light source direction implied by the shadows on the tablecloth.
